mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mrp_calc_run (batch_id, status, result_checksum, row_counts_json, started_at, finished_at, error_code, error_message) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{status}, #{resultChecksum}, #{rowCountsJson}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage})
mapper.update: UPDATE mrp_calc_run SET status=#{status}, result_checksum=#{resultChecksum}, row_counts_json=#{rowCountsJson}, started_at=#{startedAt}, finished_at=#{finishedAt}, error_code=#{errorCode}, error_message=#{errorMessage} WHERE id=#{id}
